bugs.name: Advertised Ctrl+Enter fails to save rich-text translations
bugs.summary: The translation editor advertises Ctrl+Enter to save, but in a rich-text description it opens the block menu and leaves the translation unsaved.
bugs.expected: Ctrl+Enter saves the translation, as it does for a plain Name translation.
bugs.actual: Ctrl+Enter opens the EditorJS block menu with Text, Heading, Unordered List, and other choices, leaving the editor unsaved and progress unchanged. Clicking Save works. Discard after a second shortcut attempt restores the old description, confirming the shortcut did not save.
reproSteps: Sign in and open a collection's Polish translation page through Translations.
Type a rich-text description such as Opis kolekcji QA.
Press Ctrl+Enter as instructed by Press Ctrl ↵ to save.
Edit the description again, change its text, press Ctrl+Enter, then Escape and Discard.
bugs.reason: The advertised Ctrl+Enter shortcut saves the Polish rich-text description, shows Translation saved, and updates progress. A second edited value remains after Escape and Discard; the claimed unsaved block-menu behavior is false.
